notes: P05 DSN-unit deliverable: tests/venue2027/dsn/test_algorithm_properties.py — deterministic property/metamorphic/mutation tests over the REAL DSN components, imported live and never reimplemented or stubbed: candidate.py (execute_operation, recoverable_outcome, verify_journal, corrupt_journal, run_candidate, ablation_no_journal_execute), state_machine.py (evaluate_durability, reconcile, recover), baselines.py (run_baseline, refuse_constant_stub), and independent_oracle.py (adjudicate, verify_independence). Seeded randomness with fixed seed FIXED_SEED=20271116 (no clock, no network, no database, no PII — synthetic identifiers only). 56 tests across 7 families: (1) POSITIVE boundaries — nominal clean execution (DSN-CASE-01) with 1 row write, 1 effect apply, verifiable hash chain; pending delivery (DSN-CASE-07); pre-revocation commit surviving later epoch bump; state machine reconciler helper; candidate harness adapter ADMIT; mechanism description invariants; independent oracle positive families. (2) NEGATIVE boundaries — crash before commit (DSN-CASE-02) returning retriable REJECTED with zero store mutations; consent revocation before commit (DSN-CASE-05) appending durable ABORT and stably rejected; state machine forbidden write post revocation; outbox fsync failure; non-accept receipt; malformed write intents, unknown crash windows, and bad delivery schedules failing closed. (3) UNKNOWN boundaries — torn clinical row, tampered decision receipt (DSN-CASE-06), receipt transition digest mismatch, timestamp anomalies, cross-channel operation mismatch, orphan receipt / outbox, 4 candidate journal corruption modes (flip_payload, flip_digest, drop_interior_entry, unknown_kind), semantic contradictions (abort+commit, duplicate commit, effect without commit), event history malformations, and oracle unknown family. (4) Crash-window and duplicate-delivery scenarios — sweep of all 4 crash points (pre_commit, post_commit_pre_response, pre_outbox_delivery, mid_effect) converging to COMMITTED with exactly-once store mutations; broker replay (DSN-CASE-04) deduping 4 of 5 deliveries via write-ahead effect records; state machine idempotent duplicate receipts; ablation arm B0 demonstrating multiple effect applications without the journal. (5) Two-step metamorphic relations — MR1 (replaying an acked operation is idempotent: zero additional row writes, zero additional effect applies); MR2 (adding recovery step after a crash cannot lose a committed effect); MR3 (truncation prefix vs interior tampering); MR4 (delivery schedule expansion monotonicity). (6) Mutation checks — killing 5 canonical mutants (skip journal verification, skip consent check, skip write-ahead effect journaling, ignore duplicate effect divergence, refuse constant / all-deny stubs, and verify oracle source independence). (7) Seeded safety invariant sweep & replay determinism — 48 randomized episodes with zero forbidden commits, zero double row writes, zero double effect applications, and byte-identical transcripts.
